newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Renong in Indian road contract.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Renong in Indian road contract.

text.p: Malaysia's infrastructure group Renong Bhd has won a 625 million ringgit contract to build a 120 km (74.5 miles) highway in India, a local daily reported on Monday.
Quoting Malaysian Works Minister Samy Vellu, New Straits Times said Renong would send a delegation to finalise the Bangalore-Mysore road deal with the Karnataka state government.
He said Renong would also complete construction of a 66 km ring road in Bangalore, which had been abandoned due to lack of funds.

"Due to our negotiations and frequent follow-up visits, Renong has impressed the Indian government and it is confident of securing some 800 million ringgit worth of projects in India," Samy was quoted as saying.
Renong officials were not immediately available for comment.

The minister said a Malaysian company would be submitting a proposal on the privatisation of water supply and sewerage in Bangalore. Another firm is eyeing a proposed elevated highway from Madras port to Miambakam.
